newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs Thur..
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs Thur..

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Thursday during its usual midmorning intervention period, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.
The intervention had been expected by economists.
Fed funds traded at 5-3/8 percent, the same as prior to the operation and slightly higher than the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/4 percent.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury desk 212-859-1663))
